parameters.query: WITH win AS (SELECT $1::timestamptz AS ws, $2::timestamptz AS we), signal_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS captured, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nse_symbol IS NULL) AS unresolved FROM signals WHERE posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)), context_counts AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FILTER (WHERE smc.price_at_capture IS NOT NULL) AS priced, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.nse_symbol IS NOT NULL AND smc.price_at_capture IS NULL) AS resolved_unpriced, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FILTER (WHERE smc.source='unavailable') AS quote_unavailable FROM signals s LEFT JOIN signals_market_context smc ON smc.signal_id=s.id WHERE s.posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_messages WHERE posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) AS raw_msgs, (SELECT captured FROM signal_counts) AS signals_captured, (SELECT unresolved FROM signal_counts) AS unresolved_tickers, (SELECT priced FROM context_counts) AS signals_priced, (SELECT resolved_unpriced FROM context_counts) AS resolved_missing_price, (SELECT quote_unavailable FROM context_counts) AS quote_unavailable, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(smc.slippage_pct)::numeric, 2) FROM signals_market_context smc JOIN signals s ON s.id=smc.signal_id WHERE s.posted_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win) AND smc.slippage_pct IS NOT NULL) AS avg_slippage_pct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM llm_usage WHERE error IS NOT NULL AND error<>'' AND called_at BETWEEN (SELECT ws FROM win) AND (SELECT we FROM win)) AS llm_errors_window, (SELECT updated_at FROM fyers_token WHERE id=1) AS fyers_token_updated, (SELECT MAX(posted_at) FROM signals) AS last_signal_at;
